scripts.description:
Blocks travel to any destination you could not fly back from before your current Organised Crime begins.

Also provides specific warnings when an Organised Crime is safe but cutting it fine.

Adds a 'MAX' button in trade view for quickly adding all of an item into a trade listing

Allows users to link any public online spreadsheet to the Trade view to highlight items in their inventory for trade

[Future Plan: Optional Torn ID input to connect spreadsheets to certain traders, so highlights only appear when trading with players you actually want to trade items in the spreadsheet with.]

Requires a public API key

Scans your faction (takes about a minute) and shows you which members are in which elimination team.

Every 12 hours it checks for eliminations, but this can be manually refreshed as well.

Members which leave a faction can be checked for manually, but unfortunately members who leave before your first scan will not be picked up.

Future proofed to work for elimination events in years to come - just make sure you run it from the get go, or you'll miss the leavers!

[Known bug: If a chat is open when entering a faction page the checker panel will default to opening inside the chat. Requires stricter anchoring requirements]

Small quality-of-life fixes for Torn's interface 
- Stops filter links jumping the page. E.g. stops clicking a ranking list in the Hall of Fame jumping down the page
- Adds an items-per-page selector to paged lists. E.g. See more up to 100 bounties on a single page!
- Sorts most lists and the Torn Wiki's tables by column. E.g. Sort those 100 bounties you can now see at once by level or Hosp status
- Adds a light/dark switch to the wiki
- Scrolls the news ticker with arrows for stepping through the headlines
- Offers a send form for anything bought in a shop --- WORK IN PROGRESS
- Prefil item sends with a usual preferred recipient 
- All settings optional besides Wiki settings, and can be toggled within the Torn Settings page
